method: Official public pages, directly served HTML/JavaScript and asset metadata, plus live Chrome inspection of the signup form and public homepage. No form fields filled, no account created, no emails requested.

organization.name: Pretty Good Policy for Zcash
organization.relationshipNote: Independent policy organization. Its official site states that it is not an official Zcash or Zcash Foundation product and is not endorsed by Zcash Foundation.

signup.requiredAcceptance: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Community Guidelines
signup.emailSubscriptionControlsObserved: The public signup form creates a community account through an email link. Its only visible checkbox is agreement to legal documents; no standalone newsletter or email-frequency checkbox is shown.
signup.subscriptionCaveat: The privacy policy permits newsletters and promotional email, with opt-in where required and unsubscribe links, but public signup alone does not prove which newsletter lists a new account receives. Preferences behind authentication were not inspected.
signup.membershipCaveat: The public Weekly Policy Memo card is marked Members only. Full archive access and any membership verification after account creation were not tested.
signup.suggestedHelper: Create a PGP community account with a secure email link.
signup.avoidReason: A newsletter-only enrollment flow was not verified.

evidence.verification: Public main site directs readers to community.pgpz.org for updates and participation.
Live public homepage links Join the Community to /signin?reason=signup and labels the Weekly Policy Memo as members-only.
Live browser confirmed required profile/email fields, optional social fields, legal acceptance checkbox, and disabled Send secure link button before input.
Sections 3 and 8 describe account profile information, newsletters and promotional emails, lawful consent where required, and opting out through message links or contact.

assets.role: General PGPZ organization logo for a dark feature panel
assets.usageSuggestion: Use at intrinsic ratio with object-fit contain. White lettering and gold emblem were visually verified on the official dark header. Keep the complete wordmark, including its subline.

assets.role: PGPZ Community logo for a light panel
assets.usageSuggestion: Use when the panel specifically promotes Community membership; vector remains sharp on mobile. Avoid cropping the community sublabel.

assets.role: PGPZ Community logo for a dark panel
assets.usageSuggestion: White and gold Community lockup on the official evergreen background.

assets.role: Subtle decorative circle motif for a dark panel
assets.usageSuggestion: Official hero decoration. Use as optional low-contrast background at the side of a wide panel; hide or reduce on narrow screens so it never interferes with headlines or actions.

designRecommendation.panel: One restrained feature panel with the official organization wordmark on evergreen, then title/brief policy context, latest public memo preview, and one Join PGP by email CTA. Secondary external link can open the organization site.
designRecommendation.responsive: Keep the logo contained, never stretched; place actions below copy on mobile. Do not combine both full organization and Community logos in the same panel.
designRecommendation.licensingNote: Assets are publicly served by the official sites; no separate redistribution licence was verified. They can identify the linked source, without implying partnership or endorsement.

dailyScrapeScope: Public homepage previews and public resources only. The memo archive and full memo content are members-only; daily collection must not imply that protected content was read or bypass authentication.
implementationBoundary: Research artifact only; no repository edits, subscriptions, account creation or authenticated access.
